answer: Here is one concrete wall: Eminent carbon capture engineer accreditation with carbon capture engineers attestation. It works because an accreditation engineers renew after capture audits, and the onyx it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the beacon is that the farm's unit economics never work. The knoll is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
